summary: Manual browser UI check on deployed URL (Streamlit Cloud). Root shell fully passes: sidebar, mode selector, OCR entrypoints (sidebar + main CTA), and diagnostics badge all visible with correct values. Embed route BLOCKED: Streamlit Cloud does not forward query params to st.query_params, so is_embed_route remains False despite ?embed=universe_3d in URL. Entropy misfire check passes (ENABLE_ENTROPY=unset, is_entropy_mode=False).

risks.description: Streamlit Cloud does not forward arbitrary query parameters to st.query_params. Embed route (?embed=universe_3d) is non-functional on deployed environment. Localhost testing may behave differently.
risks.mitigation: Validate embed route on localhost once environment is restored. Consider alternative embed detection (path-based or cookie-based) for cloud deployments.
